ticket.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM remedy_ticket WHERE assignee = %(assignee)s AND (((ticket_type = 'WorkOrder') AND resolved_time >= %(month_start)s AND resolved_time < %(next_month_start)s) OR ((ticket_type = 'Incident') AND limit_time >= %(month_start)s AND limit_time < %(next_month_start)s))
